body:
Owner: I read Panela, Barnett, Barense, Herrmann 2025 (Commun Psychol; EventRecall). You are right. It is not elite. It is also the published form of this code red.

What they do. GPT-4 or LLaMA copies a story and starts a new line at event boundaries. Temperature 0 becomes the normative cut. They treat twenty model runs as twenty subjects. Then they embed those narrative pieces and the recall pieces, take the max Spearman per source event, average, and call that recall. One number. They even resize the rectangular match matrix to a square with an image library so the arithmetic fits.

What that is. A provider (an LLM) writes the segmentation, then a cosine-family score treats that cut as given. Construction authority is "GPT-4, temperature 0." Alternatives from temperature 0.5 and 1 are used to talk about consistency, then dropped for the score that matters. Humans agreeing more with GPT than with each other is sold as validation. It is also a warning: the model is more stereotyped than people, and the score is being pulled toward that stereotype.

Where we can be better — if we finish the door, not if we wrap a nicer model.

- Units are not "whatever the chat completed." They are proposed, evidenced, resolved, or left Unresolved. An LLM can be a provider. It cannot be the gold cut.
- Alignment is partial, unbalanced, hierarchical. Merge, split, omit, reorder, go external. Not max-correlation after you squash the matrix square.
- The result is not one similarity number. It is a signature: coverage, compression, chronology, external mass, with receipts.
- Two segmentations of the same transcript cannot share a scientific identity just because the embedding max looks similar.
- Model samples are not subjects.

We are not elite yet. We have not published a measurement that beats this on a real corpus. If we run GraphHsmm on unlabeled RecallSegmenter units and call it better than EventRecall, we are doing the same sin with more types. The elite move is the thing they cannot say: this score is conditioned on this licensed cut, here are the alternatives, here is what was omitted.

That paper is the bar to walk past, not the architecture to copy.
